content.title: Polar Power, ZQuip collaborate to develop DC hybrid power systems
content.summary: Polar Power (POLA) announced a collaboration with ZQuip to develop and supply DC hybrid power systems tailored for construction equipment. Over the past year, Polar Power and ZQuip have jointly designed a compact diesel-fueled charging system aimed at electric construction vehicles. This solution addresses the need to reduce emissions, noise, and operational costs at both urban and remote construction sites.
